items.description: Netto is a Danish discount supermarket operating in Denmark, Germany, Poland, and Sweden. This mobile app utilizes several Dansk Supermarked APIs. The app contains: - Offers from the Net newspaper (Net newspaper) - Price Check - Use the scanner in the app to scan an item's barcode and get the price in your local Net. - Quick shopping list with bidding match (Purchase list) - The network app usually suggests purchased items and recalls what you buy. It also shows you when your items are on offer in the offer. - Sharing of your shopping list with family or friends, if you have written your shopping list on your tablet, you can also send the shopping list to your phone. - The ability to put your shopping list on your Apple Watch - Find stores and hours (Find Net).
